name: backgold-template-nonprofit
description: BackGold's party template: an Astro site on Cloudflare Workers that draws a state party's BackGold site through the Content API.

BACKGOLD_SITE_KEY.description: The site's **publishable key** (`bg_site_pk_…`). In BackGold, open **Sites → your site → Developer**; step 1 shows it. Safe to show: it only reads what the public site already shows.

SITE_URL.description: The address this site will live at, for example `https://www.example.org`. Used for canonical links, the sitemap and feeds. If the domain is not connected yet, enter the address you plan to use; you can change it later in `wrangler.jsonc`.

BACKGOLD_API_ORIGIN.description: Where BackGold's Content API lives. Keep `https://api.backgold.com` unless BackGold tells you otherwise.

BACKGOLD_CACHE.description: A KV namespace the site keeps its BackGold reads, content version and map geometry in. Cloudflare creates it for you.
